prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page built as a silkscreened character poster.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, on one continuous posted sheet, edge to edge, no margins, no cards, no navigation bar:
REGION 1, the top strip: the words HBD SUMMER PARTY in a dense condensed poster capital, printed across the top and tracked wide.
REGION 2, the centre and the whole point of the page, occupying the middle 55 percent: ONE large anthropomorphic BIRTHDAY CAKE character that is alive, standing upright on two thin legs with rounded feet, one arm raised in a big cheerful wave, with two simple round expressive eyes with tiny highlights and a small curved happy mouth. It has exactly FIVE slim lit candles on top. Around its middle it wears an INFLATABLE RING FLOAT that is oversized, fat and visibly puffy, with soft plump segment creases and a small round highlight on the tube, big enough to look genuinely inflatable and slightly comic.
REGION 3, beneath the character, large: 8.28 and 17:00 on one line in a heavy condensed poster capital, the second loudest thing on the page.
REGION 4, the bottom edge: a narrow strip carrying a small line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in tight dense condensed characters.

DRAWING STYLE: flat vector silkscreen art with VERY BOLD heavy uniform outlines, noticeably thick and confident, the weight of a screenprinted poster. No gradients, no soft shading, no drop shadows, only flat fills and a faint print grain. Charming, quirky, confident, drawn for adults rather than for a nursery.

No people, no human faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.

PALETTE AND CAKE, strictly and exactly: 
GRAPE SODA. The whole background is one flat deep VIOLET PURPLE. The cake is a TALL THREE-TIER cake with thick dripping icing running down over each tier, the tiers in bone cream and hot magenta with LIME GREEN drips. The five candles are lime green with small tangerine flames. The oversized puffy ring float is bright LIME GREEN. All outlines are deep aubergine-black. Type is bone cream on the violet ground. Colours: deep violet, lime green, hot magenta, bone cream, tangerine. No other colour. Unexpected, electric, nineties pool-inflatable energy.
